passage:
An e-book returned itself automatically on the due date. Ryan liked this because he could not forget and get a fine.
But he was annoyed when the book disappeared before he finished the last chapter. Someone else had reserved it.
The librarian explained that digital books still have lending rules because libraries buy licenses.
Ryan had thought digital meant unlimited. He learned that access depends on agreements, costs, and systems.
The invisible rules behind digital books surprised him.
A file can be copied easily, but legal access is not the same as technical possibility. Digital libraries are still libraries, with fairness to manage.

questions.stem: Which title is best for the complete passage that includes “An e-book returned itself automatically on the due date.”?
